extractions.description: The paper discusses a unifying paradigm for accelerating policy optimization methods in reinforcement learning (RL). It introduces optimism and adaptivity to foresee and adjust for errors in policy optimization. The authors leverage connections between various algorithms like policy iteration and policy gradient methods. They propose an optimistic policy gradient algorithm, using meta-gradient learning to adaptively predict future behavior of a policy. Empirical tests on an illustrative task highlight effectiveness of these design choices.
